notes_for_editor: Existence and location rest on one hobby list (tnlandforms.us, revised 2016); the entry has no GFC or datasheet number. No register, agency or news source found for a tower named color in Clinch County; the NHLR Georgia index and the easternuslookouts.weebly.com Georgia list show no such tower. The list's elevation heading has no unit; the story's 37.5 m conversion assumes feet, so it is marked as an assumption. The Clinch County tower the sources do name is Fargo, a different lookout; it was left out. Story is under the 120-word norm because the evidence is thin.
